description: Nyuchi Design sub-routes in the mukoko-edge API Gateway Worker. New routes added to the existing gateway: /v1/design/components, /v1/design/tokens, /v1/design/architecture, /v1/design/docs, /v1/design/skills, /v1/design/changelog, /v1/design/counts. Reads from Supabase grjsboqkaywpwatvrzmy (design registry project). This is not a new Worker — it is new routes in the existing mukoko-edge Worker, wiring in the design Supabase project alongside the platform Supabase projects already connected.
notes: Add to mukoko-edge repo. Wire DESIGN_SUPABASE_URL + DESIGN_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as new Worker secrets. The existing gateway already has the Supabase client pattern — this just adds a new client pointing at grjsboqkaywpwatvrzmy alongside the existing platform projects.
